notes.text: Lab 11 - DHCP Relay over EtherChannel: R1 = DHCP server (pools VLAN10/VLAN20, .1-.9 excluded), G0/0 10.0.0.1/30. DSW1 = SVIs .1 + ip helper-address 10.0.0.1, routed G0/1 to R1, LACP trunk Po1 to SW1. PCs on DHCP: PC1 VLAN10 -> 192.168.10.10, PC2 VLAN20 -> 192.168.20.10. Verify: show ip dhcp binding on R1. Try: remove helper -> DHCP fails.
